rb.text_2.OakSpeechText1.override: {text_start}你好！很高兴见到你！<LINE>欢迎来到<CONT>宝可梦的世界！<PARA>我叫大木，大家都<LINE>亲切地称我为宝可梦博士。<PROMPT>
rb.text_2.OakSpeechText1.provenance: Contextual correction of the pinned human source: removed fan-patch build date, Debug warning and cheat instructions, retaining only the original Oak introduction.

rb.text_2.OakSpeechText3.override: {text_start}<PLAYER>！<PARA>接下来，<LINE>你的故事就要开始了！<PARA>充满梦想与冒险的<LINE>宝可梦世界<CONT>正等着你！出发吧！<DONE>
rb.text_2.OakSpeechText3.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of the original Oak farewell; the untranslated Let's go and duplicated fan-patch version wording were removed.

rb.VermilionGym.VermilionGymLTSurgePreBa.override: {text_start}嘿！小鬼！<PARA>你那点半吊子本事<LINE>在战场上可是<CONT>活不下去的！<PARA>我在战争中<LINE>就是靠电属性宝可梦<CONT>活下来的！<PARA>它们会把敌人电麻，<LINE>让对手无法动弹！<PARA>你也会和他们<LINE>落得同样的下场！<DONE>
rb.VermilionGym.VermilionGymLTSurgePreBa.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of Lt. Surge's pre-battle speech; the character's military tone is retained without mixed English.

rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgePos.override: {text_start}小鬼，再给你<LINE>一个建议！<PARA>电属性招式<LINE>威力很强！<PARA>不过面对地面属性时，<LINE>可是一点作用<CONT>也没有！<DONE>
rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgePos.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of Lt. Surge's type-matchup advice; mixed English from the fan source was removed.

rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgeThu.override: {text_start}持有橙色徽章，<LINE>宝可梦的速度<CONT>会提高！<PARA>而且可以在战斗外<LINE>使用招式“飞翔”！<PARA>你很特别，<LINE>这是我的一点心意！<DONE>
rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgeThu.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of Lt. Surge's badge explanation; mixed English from the fan source was removed.

rb.VermilionGym_2.TM24ExplanationText.override: {text_start}<PARA>招式学习器２４是<LINE>“十万伏特”！<PARA>请把它教给<LINE>电属性宝可梦吧！<DONE>
rb.VermilionGym_2.TM24ExplanationText.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of the TM24 explanation; the move and Electric-type terminology follow the surrounding Chinese catalog.

rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgeTM2.override: {text_start}你的背包满了！<LINE>已经拿不下了！<DONE>
rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgeTM2.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of the full-pack response after receiving TM24.

rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgeRec.override: {text_start}哦，不！<PARA>你的实力货真价实！<LINE>你是真的很厉害！<PARA>好！<LINE>橙色徽章就交给你了！<PROMPT>
rb.VermilionGym_2.VermilionGymLTSurgeRec.provenance: Contextual Chinese translation of Lt. Surge conceding and awarding the Thunder Badge.
